comment: P26 ROUND 1 precommitted thresholds — measured on 1280x720 PNGs, mean luminance Rec.709 (0..255). Sky band = top 25% of frame. All thresholds were fixed BEFORE the candidate render and are not softened afterwards.

round3_roi_correction.comment: ROUND 3 measurement-correction (documented in QA_MATRIX.md §3/§5). Pixel forensics showed the legacy rift/halo ROIs are dominated by glow-lit background + horizon sky, not portal content. G1 delta-vs-BEFORE condition unsatisfiable against the old ROI (BEFORE night rift 50.3 > 40). New definitions are pixel-derived from the committed render forensics (tools/p26_forensics_v2.py): G1b = the actual void interior (darkest contiguous cells, mean 24.5-31.7); G2b = portal-content band minus a same-frame reference band (isolates portal energy from E2-mandated bright noon background). Legacy gates are still measured and reported for transparency.
